text:
jamie: Quick heads up — we need to finalize the assessor glidepath access for the external assessment next week. Proposed window: Tue 2024-05-14 09:00-13:00 PT. Need RBAC snapshot, ephemeral creds, KMS read-only proxy, and audit-log retention plan. Who can own what?
kevin: I can handle the ephemeral RBAC roles + assume-role flow. Plan is to create timeboxed roles with session duration 4h and require MFA. Will add a tag `assessment=true` so we can track.
olivia: I'll take KMS & logging. For KMS we should avoid giving decrypt; allow DescribeKey + Encrypt for proofs, plus a proxy that performs decrypts behind an auditor service if needed. Also will confirm CloudTrail -> S3 export TTL.
sec-bot: [automated] Created ticket SEC-4672: "Assessors - glidepath access setup" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4672 :eyes:
oncall-sre: I'll coordinate the canary and slot the infra change in the 08:30 maintenance window. We'll mirror CloudTrail and VPC flow logs to the assessment-bucket with 90d retention and object-lock disabled (to allow evidence packaging).
jamie: Nice. kevin — can you paste the minimal IAM policy snippet you plan to attach to the ephemeral role? want to review before you push.
kevin: sure. putting snippet here:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessment-ephemeral-*" },
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["iam:GetRole", "iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies"], "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```
kevin: session policy will further restrict to read-only ops on target buckets and DescribeKey on the KMS key.
olivia: For the KMS proxy, I'll run a small Lambda with a limited API that returns only metadata and audit-hashes. No raw plaintext in logs. Key policy will add a condition restrict to `aws:PrincipalTag/assessment=true`.
jamie: Audit checklist we require before handing to assessor: 1) RBAC snapshot (repo link), 2) CloudTrail export with hash, 3) KMS key policy snapshot, 4) evidence bundle in presigned S3 path. Anyone object?
oncall-sre: No objections. Note: S3 presigned uploads should use signed URLs with 6h expiry and server-side encryption with customer-managed key (SSE-KMS). We'll rotate the key alias after the window.
kevin: For evidence packaging I'm proposing a temporary bucket `assessment-evidence-<ts>` with lifecycle 30d and a manifest.json containing SHA256 checksums. Example upload command:
```bash
aws s3 cp findings.json s3://assessment-evidence-1738520000/findings.json --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/assessment-evidence
sha256sum findings.json > findings.json.sha256
aws s3 cp findings.json.sha256 s3://assessment-evidence-1738520000/
```
olivia: Reminder: scrub any PII or customer identifiers before uploading. We'll keep a sanitized and a redacted copy; redacted copy for the assessors.
jamie: Retest gating: require all critical/major tickets fixed + evidence bundle + RBAC & KMS snapshots + CloudTrail hashes. If any of those are missing, we ask for a 48h freeze. OK?
kevin: Agree. I'll create the ephemeral roles now in dev and post the role ARNs + terraform diff into SEC-4672.
olivia: I'll provision the KMS proxy and add a runbook section: how to request decrypts (only via sec-ops + recorded call).
jamie: To assign owners inside the ticket: kevin -> role + terraform, olivia -> kms + logs, jamie -> assessor coordination + evidence acceptance, oncall-sre -> infra window + canary. Tagging @oncall-sre and @sec-bot for visibility. :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre: ACK. Calendar invite created and runbook link added: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/assessor-glidepath. I'll also drop a pre-window checklist reminder 24h before.
jamie: Thanks all — let's reconvene in #eng-security 24h before the window for a final go/no-go.
kevin: will post role ARNs + terraform plan in the ticket shortly.
olivia: pushing KMS proxy PR to staging, will request review from @jamie.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-4672 updated: assignees set to kevin, olivia, jamie, oncall-sre. Due date set to 2024-05-13.
